name: Gasthof Himmelhof
kurzbeschreibung:
**Inn Himmelhof in Schwaz**

Discover authentic Tyrolean hospitality in the heart of the **Zillertal Alps**, just a short drive from **Innsbruck**. Our family-run **Gasthof Himmelhof** invites you to unwind in a cozy mountain atmosphere, where traditional Tyrolean charm meets modern comfort.

Savor hearty **Kaiserschmarrn**, fresh **Apfelstrudel**, and other regional specialties in our rustic dining room. After a day of hiking, skiing, or exploring the historic **Schwaz**, relax by the crackling fireplace with a glass of local **Apfelwein** or **Grauburgunder**.

Our rooms—whether classic alpine or modern—offer breathtaking views of the surrounding peaks. Whether you're seeking adventure or tranquility, **Gasthof Himmelhof** is your perfect retreat in **Tirol**.
